# Verify

> Verify (@revyl/verify) is an open-source TypeScript library for Revyl. It opens cloud browsers and iOS/Android devices for agent instruction/validation steps, or Mac and Linux computers for commands, files, processes, screenshots, and optional private recording metadata after release. Call it from a plain script, coding agent, CI, or any test runner. It has no test runner of its own.

## Docs

Both computer operating systems are early access; ask support@revyl.ai about access. Linux init remains intentionally unavailable; use an inline target or config entry. See computers.md#availability-and-errors.

- [Getting started](getting-started.md): install, authenticate, init, run a script
- [API](api.md): open(), attach(), hosted children, navigate(), report(), agent steps, screenshot(), exec(), file/process methods, close()
- [Configuration](configuration.md): verify.config.ts targets, environment variables, the init and whoami commands
- [Web](web.md): Revyl web sessions, URLs and builds, sign-in, and steps
- [Mobile](mobile.md): iOS and Android devices and installing apps
- [Computers](computers.md#availability-and-errors): Mac/Linux early access, expiry, capacity errors, recording metadata, and confirmed release
- [Verify working end to end](end-to-end.md): live verification scope, observed outcomes, and limits of the evidence
- [CI and test runners](ci.md): GitHub Actions, node:test, Vitest, Jest, Playwright Test
- [Errors](errors.md): every error code and what to do about it
- [For coding agents](agents.md): the workflow and rules for agents using Verify
